author: John Hay, John G. Nicolay
claims: The Gettysburg Address is a model of brevity, directness, terse diction, exact and lucid historical statement.
The Gettysburg Address contains logical propositions that are short and strong, resembling mathematical axioms.
The Gettysburg Address is pervaded by an elevation of thought and aim that lifts it out of the commonplace of mere party controversy.
The Gettysburg Address contains the argument of the hour and the premonition of broader issues.
The main reasoning of the Gettysburg Address vindicates and restores the policy of the fathers of the country in the restriction of slavery.
The Gettysburg Address demonstrates the essential injustice and immorality of slavery.
